gates.name: Advanced curriculum
criteria: Pedagogically coherent and deep 14-subject beginner-to-advanced paths
Multiple well-validated questions, worked examples and real practice per topic
Primary official links and jurisdiction-correct Philippine legal guidance editorially verified
Latest curriculum CI plus accessibility tests pass

evidence.note: Three-stage learning objectives and actual per-subject lesson paths across 14 subjects.
Three original PH data privacy, bank and DTI case-study lessons with official source links.
28 original, subject-specific decision-check questions with offline persistence and source references.
Automated test/build/browser verification passed for the decision clinic release.
Twelve previously short advanced foundation lessons now have substantive applied section, worked example and supporting source.
Successful unit, offline-build and desktop/mobile Chromium verification for the advanced enrichment release.
Every one of 134 lessons now has a two-step evidence-check and transfer-challenge guide specific to subject and level, without mutating frozen source content.
23 previously short worked examples and 20 brief answer rationales expanded with concrete subject-specific reasoning.
201 unit tests passed; production build and full real Chromium desktop/mobile/offline suite passed. Coverage: 134/134 worked examples, answer rationales, source links and guided reflection prompts.
Deepened 18 high-stakes Philippine legal, finance, digital-security and anti-coercion foundation lessons with specific applied cases.
Expanded 16 psychology, business, time and language foundations with evidence-based examples and assignments.
Expanded 18 communication, reasoning, career, science, relationships and negotiation foundation lessons.
Addressed 11 remaining section-depth and applied-task gaps in the sourced applied and advanced learning library.

209 passing unit tests, verified static/offline build and desktop/mobile Chromium integration. Automated audit: 134/134 sections, examples, assignments, rationales, guided practice, links; 0 structural flags.

blockers: Independent qualified subject-matter reviewers have not signed off all 134 lessons, especially applicable Philippine legal/financial rules, health/safety claims and cultural context.
Automated coverage checks prove structure and code behavior, not the substantive correctness, reliability or psychometric validation of every lesson and quiz.

The 41 public source URLs and each material claim still require a dated per-claim substantive editorial review; automated link reachability or maintainer spot-checks are insufficient for certification.
